newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products all rise, following crude strengt.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all rise, following crude strengt.

text.p: NWE oil products all firmed on Tuesday, largely because of Brent crude strength late on Monday, dealers said.

Heating oil barges were up by almost $3 a tonne as IPE March futures rose. However, premiums were not expected to rise any higher than IPE March parity as milder weather continued. Late on Monday, a couple of refinery material loads sold at IPE March +50 cents fob Rotterdam.
High sulphur fuel oil barges also headed up, trading at $92 fob Antwerp and fob Rotterdam.
